Council news

The council meets on Thursday at 6 pm in the main hall. The agenda covers the new library, the river path, the skate park and the market. Everyone is welcome; the meeting is also streamed online and the recording is posted the next day with the minutes.

The budget hearing follows on the first Monday of next month. Written comments can be sent to the clerk until the Friday before, and every comment is read into the record at the start of the hearing.
